# Nexora

> Nexora is a modern online marketplace where independent sellers offer products across categories with transparent shipping, ratings, and reviews.

Nexora connects shoppers and sellers in a single storefront. Buyers can search the catalog, compare carriers, calculate shipping by ZIP code, and check out securely. Sellers can list and manage their own products.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured banner, search, and category navigation.
- [All products](/products): Full catalog with filters, sorting, and pagination.
- [Sell on Nexora](/sell): List a product as a seller.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the Nexora support team.
- [About](/about): Company overview and mission.
- [History](/history): Milestones and company journey.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use and legal information.

## Optional

- [Cart](/cart): Shopper-only shopping cart view.
- [Favorites](/favorites): Shopper-only saved products.
- [Sign in](/login): Account access for shoppers and sellers.
